fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $40,000. Current franchisees in full compliance purchasing a second or additional Restaurant pay a reduced fee of $30,000. Fee is due upon execution of the Franchise Agreement, is fully earned upon payment, and is non-refundable. Area Development Agreement fee structure: $40,000 for first Restaurant plus $30,000 for each additional Restaurant; no additional initial franchise fee is required when executing individual Franchise Agreements under an Area Development Agreement.
raw_excerpt: You will pay a $40,000 lump sum initial franchise fee for the right to own and operate a Restaurant.  If you are a current franchisee and are in full compliance under all Cupbop® Franchise Agreements and are purchasing your second or additional Restaurant, the initial franchise fee is reduced to $30,000.
